mappa.grp.row: Group row in the table of marked points (HR only); {g} = group number, {shape} = name of the shape of its points, {n} = how many points, {members} = numbers of the points.
mappa.grp.fold: Button that collapses the row of a group of marked points; {g} = group number.
mappa.grp.unfold: Button that expands the row of a group of marked points; {g} = group number.
mappa.tab.ref.pick: Button of the table of marked points in the map; {n} = point number.
mappa.lbl.tip: Tooltip of an m/z label of the map's side spectrum; {mz} = m/z of the peak, {snr} = local signal-to-noise ratio.
mappa.read.scan: Readout of the map crosshair; {n} = sequence number of the scan in the file.
mappa.tab.title: Title of the table of marked points under the map; {n} = how many points.
mapnav.where: First line of the map's right-click menu; {at} = already formatted coordinates (RT, m/z, intensity) of the point the commands act on.
mapnav.where.locked: Same as above, when the crosshair is locked; {at} = already formatted coordinates of the locked point.
mapex.spec.cap: Caption under the map's side spectrum; {a} and {b} = ends of the panel's RT window, in minutes, already formatted.
mappa.uv.side: Caption under the right strip of a DAD map: UV spectrum at the cursor time; {rt} = time in min.
mappa.uv.sideDiff: Caption under the right strip of a subtracted DAD map; {rt} = time in min.
mappa.uv.bot: Title of the bottom strip of a DAD map: absorbance against time at the cursor wavelength; {lo},{hi} = band in nm, {max} = maximum.
mappa.uv.botDiff: Title of the bottom strip of a subtracted DAD map; {lo},{hi} = band in nm, {max} = largest absolute value.
mappa.ms.side: Title of the right strip of a DAD map in MS mode: {file} file, {rt} MS retention time, {dad} cursor time, {off} signed offset.
mappa.ms.sideNone: Right strip of a DAD map in MS mode when the file has no scan there.
mappa.ms.fail: Shown in an MS strip of a DAD map when the engine could not read the MS; {file} the file name.
mappa.ms.noAxis: Shown in an MS strip of a DAD map when the file has no MS scan list; {file} the file name.
mappa.ms.noMz: Shown in the bottom strip of a DAD map when the EIC is chosen but no m/z is typed.
mappa.ms.bot: Title of the bottom strip of a DAD map in MS mode: {kind} trace name, {file} file, {off} offset.
mappa.ms.mz: Axis label of the MS1 spectrum in the right strip.
mappa.ms.wait: Placeholder of the strips while the MS is read.
